title: Local sums identify traces under etale localization
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be finite etale and $g:X^{\prime}\to X$ etale [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put $Y^{\prime}=Y\times_XX^{\prime}$ and $f^{\prime}:Y^{\prime}\to X^{\prime}$, and for an abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ put $F^{\prime}=g^{-1}F$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Suppose $\tau:f_*f^{-1}F\to F$ and $\tau^{\prime}:f^{\prime}_*(f^{\prime})^{-1}F^{\prime}\to F^{\prime}$ both satisfy their local sum predicates [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace-local-sums]. For every object $W$ over $X^{\prime}$ and every pasting isomorphism $\kappa_W:W\times_{X^{\prime}}Y^{\prime}\simeq W\times_XY$ whose projections are $\mathrm{id}_W$ and the projection to $Y$ [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting], the transported trace components satisfy $\rho^g_F(W)\circ\overline\tau^{\prime}_W=\overline\tau_W\circ F(\kappa_W^{-1})\circ\rho^g_F(W\times_{X^{\prime}}Y^{\prime})$. Here $\rho^g_F:g^{-1}F\simeq F|_{X^{\prime}}$ and each bar denotes composition with the inverse restriction isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction]. No relationship between the choices of $\tau$ and $\tau^{\prime}$ is assumed beyond these predicates.

proof.text: The local sum formula for the unlocalized trace is transported through the restriction and pasting isomorphisms by finiteEtaleTrace_localization_section_formula, while localSum_section_formula gives the corresponding formula for the localized trace. The uniqueness equalities identify the two sections; postcompose with the restriction isomorphism and cancel its inverse to obtain the asserted equality of natural-transformation components, then use concrete extensionality.
